Figure 1:Our proposed Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens).The vision encoder lens (V-Lens) reads object and colour concepts across image patches, while the language decoder lens (L-Lens) tracks how the question changes concept accessibility in the decoder.
Both use a shared output vocabulary.
Decoder numbers are vocabulary ranks, with smaller values indicating greater concept accessibility.
